name: Groundfloor
title: Kiavi vs. Groundfloor
summary: Groundfloor is a crowdfunded hard money lender known for low minimum loan amounts and deferred payments; Kiavi is the volume leader with faster institutional-grade closings and a full rental (DSCR) product line.

Best for: High-volume flippers and investors who also need DSCR rental loans
Smaller first deals and borrowers who want deferred monthly payments
Max LTC / ARV: Up to 100% LTC on some loans / ~75% ARV
Income verification: No W-2 or income docs on bridge loans
New-customer offer: $350 cash after first closed loan via referral link

kiaviWins: Scale and speed. Kiavi funded more fix-and-flip volume than any US lender in 2024, closes in days rather than weeks, and keeps you in one ecosystem when a flip turns into a rental (bridge to 30-year DSCR). Pricing at the low end of the hard-money range for experienced borrowers.
theyWin: Smaller deals and payment flexibility. Groundfloor's minimums are lower, it can defer monthly payments until payoff, and it occasionally funds up to 100% of costs on strong deals — useful if cash is the constraint on your first flip.
verdict: Pick Kiavi if you want the fastest close, competitive experienced-investor pricing, and a lender that can carry you from flip to rental. Pick Groundfloor for a small first deal where deferred payments matter more than speed.

name: Lima One Capital
title: Kiavi vs. Lima One Capital
summary: Both are national, institutionally backed lenders for residential investors. Lima One (a MFA Financial company) is strong on new construction and multifamily; Kiavi leads on fix-and-flip volume, speed, and a tech-first application.

Best for: Fix-and-flip and DSCR rental at speed, tech-first process
New construction and multifamily value-add projects
New-customer offer: $350 cash after first closed loan via referral link

kiaviWins: Speed and simplicity on 1–4 unit deals. The application is online end-to-end, bridge loans skip income verification entirely, and experienced flippers get the most competitive pricing tier in the space.
theyWin: Project breadth. Lima One goes where Kiavi doesn't: ground-up construction at scale and 5+ unit multifamily. If your pipeline includes apartment buildings, you'll need a lender like Lima One anyway.
verdict: For 1–4 unit flips and rentals, Kiavi is faster and usually cheaper. For multifamily or heavy ground-up construction, Lima One's product set is the better fit.

name: RCN Capital
title: Kiavi vs. RCN Capital
summary: RCN Capital is a wholesale-friendly national private lender with a broad box; Kiavi is a direct, tech-driven lender with the largest fix-and-flip volume in the country.

Best for: Direct borrowers who want the fastest online process
Broker-sourced deals and borrowers who like negotiating terms
New-customer offer: $350 cash after first closed loan via referral link

kiaviWins: Borrower experience and leverage. Higher max LTC/ARV, a fully online process with instant soft-quote pricing, and no income docs on bridge loans. Kiavi's 2024 origination volume was more than triple any competitor's.
theyWin: Flexibility at the margins. RCN's minimum loan size is lower ($50K), and as a wholesale-first shop it can be more negotiable on unusual deals that don't fit a standardized box.
verdict: Most direct borrowers get better leverage, speed, and pricing at Kiavi. RCN makes sense for sub-$100K properties or if you work through a broker who has pull there.

name: Upright (Fund That Flip)
title: Kiavi vs. Upright (formerly Fund That Flip)
summary: Upright (rebranded from Fund That Flip in 2023) pairs hard money lending with a passive-investor funding marketplace; Kiavi is a pure direct lender with institutional capital and bigger scale.

Best for: Investors who want the biggest, fastest direct lender
Experienced flippers in Upright's regional strongholds (Midwest/Northeast)
Experience requirement: None — new investors eligible (pricing tiers by exits)
New-customer offer: $350 cash after first closed loan via referral link

kiaviWins: Access and scale. Kiavi lends to first-time flippers, covers nearly every state, offers true 30-year DSCR takeout loans, and prices experienced borrowers aggressively because of its securitization-backed capital base.
theyWin: Relationship lending for proven flippers. Upright's regional teams know their Midwest/Northeast markets deeply and can move quickly for repeat borrowers with a track record.
verdict: Kiavi for national coverage, first-timers, and flip-to-rental strategies. Upright for experienced flippers already in its core markets who value a regional relationship.

name: New Silver
title: Kiavi vs. New Silver
summary: New Silver is a fintech hard money lender known for instant online term sheets and crypto-adjacent funding rails; Kiavi is the category's volume leader with deeper products and cheaper experienced-investor pricing.

Best for: Fast online term sheets on smaller East Coast deals
Max LTC / ARV: Up to 100% of construction / ~92.5% LTC / 80% ARV
New-customer offer: $350 cash after first closed loan via referral link

kiaviWins: Pricing depth and proven scale. Experienced investors typically price lower at Kiavi, the DSCR product is more mature, and $30B+ in originations means underwriting rarely surprises you at the closing table.
theyWin: Leverage on construction budgets. New Silver funds up to 100% of rehab/construction costs on qualifying deals and advertises slightly higher ARV limits, which can mean less cash in on heavy rehabs.
verdict: Both are fast, online-first lenders. Kiavi usually wins on rate and product depth; New Silver is worth a term-sheet comparison on heavy-rehab deals where construction leverage drives your cash-to-close.
